responsibilities-after-the-repair.text: Eleven modules. The fold owns a reject's refund duties with no timing rule. The request script admits its spend in the processing window or when the state rejects that same request. The old predicate is removed. Tests and properties restate the model's rule. Identity files carry regenerated hashes. The builder drops its timing. The end to end test proves it. The story language names a reject's window, the interpreter realizes it, the rows own their verdicts, and publication states the current behaviour.

dependency-direction.text: No dependency changes direction. The validators know nothing of the builder or the suite. The only new read is the request script reading the state's redeemer in the same transaction, which it already locates.

promotion.text: Nothing is promoted to a shared library.
